Jordan — thanks for the detail and the attachments, that helped. Quick checks we've done:
- The invite link generated for Sprout looks valid and points to our Coupa tenant endpoint.
- The frontend logs show a redirect to your configured IdP (SAML) with relayState present.

Two immediate asks so we can triage faster:
1) Can you confirm whether your IdP expects a specific RelayState value or a signed request? Some customers set a strict relayState whitelist which will drop anything unexpected.
2) If your IT team can open the SSO logs for the exact timestamp in the trace (2026-08-04T16:11:12Z) we can confirm whether the SAML Assertion was rejected or if your IdP is truncating the RelayState.

Ben — can you run a quick check on tenant mapping for Sprout (tenant id sprout-devices-prod) and confirm whether we recently rotated any relayState shims? If that looks clear, we may need a temporary invite that bypasses tenant binding.

Jordan — I'll keep you posted and loop in engineering if we hit a tenant-binding rejection. If you prefer a manual activation in the portal we can do that while we investigate.

— Olga

message_3:

Subject: Re: Activation link consistently redirects to our SSO — can't accept PO

Olga / Monica — I pulled the tenant mapping for sprout-devices-prod and there were no recent changes to the relayState wrapper in the last 30 days. Couple of findings from infra:
- Our sign-in token uses a short-lived auth token plus relayState. If the incoming request already has an active SSO session cookie for a different org, the middleware forces a re-auth flow which can loop for cross-tenant sessions.
- The trace indicates the RelayState contains an extra URL-encoded context param ("ctx=%7B%22src%22%3A%22email_invite%22%7D") that some legacy IdP configs choke on.

Recommended mitigation for immediate unblock: publish a one-off activation URL without the extra context param (we can generate and set TTL 24h). Jordan, if you confirm it's safe we can send that link and you can accept then we confirm the PO visibility and invoices.

I've created a ticket with engineering: ONB-1198 and linked the trace. If this happens again we'll push a small shim to strip non-critical RelayState keys for email invites.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Ops — Onboarding
Redwood Inference
